name: skinn
description: Search Skinn’s public beauty product catalog, inspect existing ingredient information and available scores, and browse dated skincare product descriptions by category. Open a product card or look up a known barcode. This integration does not process selfies, access private analyses, diagnose skin conditions or provide personalized medical advice.
